description: Use this when the person wants to change something on one of their palimpalem websites: texts, titles, photos, sections, new pages ("add a page about …", added to the menu, sitemap and llms.txt), colours and style, contact details, WhatsApp button, SEO title. Requires palimpalem sign-in. Takes the change in plain words, carries it out and says exactly what changed. To work on another page than the home page give page; to aim at one element give element (ids from ver_mi_web). To put an own photo of the person in place of an existing one give photo_url (a public https address of a JPG, PNG or WebP) and element (the id of the photo); photo_edit improves (light, colour, sharpness) or crops an own photo to fit its place. Changes are saved and visible right away; each one can be undone (also by asking to undo the last change, or with versiones_web). Translations follow automatically. Does not touch domain, e-mail, payments or the account. Takes 5 to 60 seconds.

element.description: Optional. Element id from ver_mi_web (e.g. b12) to aim the change at. Required with photo_url and photo_edit (the id of the photo).

page.description: Optional. The page to change (name from ver_mi_web, e.g. "menu"). Without it, the home page.

photo_edit.description: Optional. improve: better light, colour and sharpness; fit: crop to the shape of its place around the main subject. Only for the website's own photos (also right after photo_url).

photo_url.description: Optional. Public https address of a photo (JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 15 MB) that replaces the photo at element. It is copied to the website.

request.description: The change in plain words, in any language, e.g. "Change the main title to Fresh bread every morning" or "Add a section with opening hours: Mon-Fri 8-14". Optional when only photo_url or photo_edit is given.

web.description: The website: its name, its palimpalem address or its own domain.

name: editar_web
title: Change my website
